scripts/native_release_gate.py

Python · Tier B

Require complete native release evidence for both roles on all four targets.

Usage

Pass native release directories to this CLI before publication.

Inputs

Manifests, checksums, acceptance records, clean-machine proof and SBOMs.

Side effects

Reads and validates release files; prints success or raises on missing, stale, unsigned or otherwise unresolved release evidence; never publishes artifacts.

Cleanup

No temporary state or background processes are created.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py

@see scripts/binary_verify.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
release_gate 29 Reject incomplete target/role sets or evidence not bound to the final artifact hashes. Require clean official builds, native signatures where applicable, notarization on macOS, successful independent acceptance, and schema-valid runtime and distribution SBOMs. Verification is read-only and failures raise ValueError.
